div.div:
Windows service “Pitwall”
[Service Control Manager · LocalSystem]
Thin supervisor pitwall-server --service: starts the server in the user’s session (active, then console, then lowest id) and again when it exits; restarts after 10 s, 60 s, 5 min.

[runs as the logged-on user]

div.div:
systemd user service
[~/.config/systemd/user/pitwall.service]
Written by pitwall-server install: Restart=always, no administrator rights. Running without a login needs loginctl enable-linger, the user’s choice.
